pages.title: Crab Chitin
pages.text: A plate of a yeti crab's shell: chitin, the sugar-chain plastic of every shell and insect wing. Dropped by Vent Crabs in Titan's hidden ocean. The Chemical Reactor turns it into polymer sheet (chitosan).
$(thing)Dropped by$(): Vent Crab.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Polymer Sheet.
